confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors use mid-2026 aggregated Zurich prices. The cocktail estimate follows a reported local bar range; wine uses a local menu-price median. Hostel anchors estimate typical annual prices from current listings, so seasonal variation and private-room pricing add uncertainty. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; restaurant and hostel estimates are Zurich-specific, while hotel prices are holistic estimates.
